# openmetadata_role Data Source

Looks up a single OpenMetadata role by id or fully qualified name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "openmetadata_role" "data_steward" {
  fully_qualified_name = "DataSteward"
}

output "data_steward_role_id" {
  value = data.openmetadata_role.data_steward.id
}

output "data_steward_role_policies" {
  value = data.openmetadata_role.data_steward.policies
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `fully_qualified_name` (String) Role fully qualified name. Exactly one of id or fully_qualified_name must be set.
- `id` (String) Role UUID. Exactly one of id or fully_qualified_name must be set.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) Markdown description.
- `display_name` (String) Human-readable name.
- `name` (String) Role name.
- `policies` (Set of String) Fully qualified names of the policies granted to the role. The server sorts the list, so it is modelled as a set.
- `updated_at` (String) Last update time in RFC 3339 format.
- `updated_by` (String) User that performed the last update.
- `version` (Number) Server-side entity version.
